eccc_province.title: ECCC Province
eccc_province.description: Creates an entity for every active alert across the whole province. To match only your location, go back and choose GPS location or device tracker instead.

data_description.gps_loc: Latitude,Longitude (e.g. 52.5200,13.4050). Filters by per-warning polygons; fails loud if the country does not publish geometry.

data_description.tracker_entity: Device tracker providing coordinates for polygon narrowing. Warnings without per-warning geometry are kept, so countries that publish none degrade to country-wide alerts.
data_description.country_entity: Entity whose value names the current country (e.g. sensor.geolocator_country). Accepts an ISO-2 code or a country name.
data_description.country_attribute: Optional attribute to read the country from instead of the entity's state.

data_description.regions: Select one or more regions to filter alerts. You can also type a region code (e.g. FI810) that isn't listed — the list only shows regions named by warnings currently in the feed.

data_description.source_id: Pick a source from the live WMO SWIC registry, or type a custom source ID (e.g. mx-smn-es for Mexico) if yours is not listed. European and US users are better served by the dedicated MeteoAlarm and NWS providers; US alerts fetched via WMO recreate their entities on each lifecycle change (NEW/CON/CAN).

data_description.gps_loc: Latitude,Longitude (e.g. 19.4326,-99.1332). Filters by per-alert polygons; fails loud if the source does not publish geometry.

data_description.geocode_prefixes: Comma-separated area-code prefixes (e.g. 13,37). Fetches the whole country, then keeps only alerts whose area codes start with one of them. Codes are hierarchical, so a shorter prefix covers a wider area (13 = Hebei, 1307 = Zhangjiakou). Use this for sources that publish no per-alert polygons, where GPS filtering cannot work. Code lengths vary, so prefer the leading digits over pasting a full code. Editable later under Configure.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the weather service.
error.cannot_fetch_regions: Could not load regions for this country. Try again or pick a different filter mode.
error.invalid_country: Invalid country code. Use a MeteoAlarm-supported ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.
error.invalid_geocode_prefix: Invalid area code prefix. Enter a comma-separated list of codes made up of letters, digits, and : _ . - (max 32 characters each).
error.invalid_gps: Invalid GPS coordinates. Enter as latitude,longitude.
error.invalid_wmo_source: Invalid WMO source ID. Select from the list or enter a valid source ID (e.g. mx-smn-es).
error.unknown_country_feed: MeteoAlarm no longer publishes a feed for this country. Pick another, or report it so the country list can be updated.
error.unknown_wmo_source: The WMO mirror does not publish this source. Pick one from the list — some registered sources are only served on national sites, which this integration cannot read.
error.unknown_zone: No such NWS zone. The format is right, but the National Weather Service does not publish a zone with that ID — check it at weather.gov/zones.

abort.already_configured: This location is already set up. Reconfigure the existing entry instead of adding a second one for the same scope.
abort.no_regions_available: This country's MeteoAlarm feed names no regions to pick from. Set the integration up again and choose Country-wide instead.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to check for new alerts (60–3600). ECCC: applies only when real-time streaming is off.
data_description.language: Preferred alert language. ECCC: auto/en-CA/fr-CA. MeteoAlarm: auto plus 2-letter ISO codes. WMO: auto, or any BCP 47 tag the source publishes (e.g. zh-Hans); the source falls back to English when it does not carry your language.
data_description.streaming: Stream ECCC alerts over the NAAD real-time feed for near-instant updates (recommended). When off, alerts are polled from the GeoRSS feed on the polling interval. ECCC only.
data_description.feed_source: Which NAAD GeoRSS host(s) to fetch. 'auto' combines both feeds so no alert carried by only one is missed (recommended). The legacy host retires around September 2026; pin a single host only to work around a specific feed issue. ECCC only.
data_description.exclude_marine: Hide alerts issued for marine/water zones (boating, open water). NWS and ECCC only.
data_description.gdacs_event_types: Which GDACS hazards to track. Filtering happens before any alert is fetched, so narrowing this also cuts the fetch cost. Leave every type selected (the default) to track them all, including hazards GDACS adds later. GDACS only.
data_description.alert_level: Lowest GDACS alert level to fetch: Green (all), Orange, or Red. This is GDACS's own impact scale, not CAP severity: it decides which events are fetched, not how they are shown. Raise it to cut the volume of green earthquakes. GDACS only.
data_description.geocode_prefixes: Optional. Comma-separated area-code prefixes (e.g. 13,37). Keeps only alerts whose area codes start with one of them, on top of the location filter chosen at setup. Codes are hierarchical, so a shorter prefix covers a wider area (13 = Hebei, 1307 = Zhangjiakou). Matched against every code scheme the source publishes. Code lengths vary within a scheme, so pasting a full code may match nothing — prefer the leading digits. Leave empty to disable.

error.invalid_geocode_prefix: Invalid area code prefix. Use a comma-separated list of codes made up of letters, digits, and : _ . - (max 32 characters each).
